one_liner: Modern CRM with robust developer tools and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
access_notes: Full REST API and MCP access are included on all plans, including the free tier.
verdict_reason: Attio provides self-serve API keys and OAuth 2.0 on all pricing tiers (including free), along with an official hosted MCP server.

evidence.snippet:
In order to make requests to the Attio REST API, you need to generate an access token. There are two ways to generate an access token:

1. By implementing an OAuth 2.0 flow
2. By generating an API key for your workspace
Attio MCP is Attio’s hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.

The Attio REST API exchanges JSON over HTTPS at https://api.attio.com/v2. It exposes the full workspace surface: objects, attributes, records, lists, entries, notes, tasks, comments, threads, meetings, call recordings, transcripts, files, workspace members, and webhooks.

agent_notes: Attio offers both a REST API and a hosted MCP server (mcp.attio.com/mcp) with comprehensive CRM tool coverage.
